classes.label: Weird geometry
classes.hint: does not blend with the part, looks wrong, not cohesive design
classes.meaning: This geometry does not blend with the part or make cohesive design sense; simplify or rebuild it so it reads as one intentional shape.

classes.label: Incoherent addition
classes.hint: added geometry satisfies the words but does not fit the part
classes.meaning: This added feature satisfies the request on paper but does not fit the part; redesign it so it belongs to the part's form and purpose.

classes.label: Collateral damage
classes.hint: an edit fixed one thing and broke neighbouring geometry
classes.meaning: An edit changed or broke geometry here that was not part of the request; restore it to how it was before that edit.

classes.label: Floating or unsupported
classes.hint: touches nothing, hangs in the air, no load path
classes.meaning: This touches nothing or has no load path; connect it to the structure it should sit on or remove it.

classes.label: Orientation or mirror
classes.meaning: This is on the wrong side, flipped, mirrored or rotated; put it in the orientation the design intends.

classes.label: Fit or clearance
classes.hint: interference, too tight, too loose, wrong gap
classes.meaning: The fit here is wrong (interference, too tight or too loose); fix the clearance so the mating parts fit as intended.

classes.label: Printability
classes.hint: overhangs, thin walls, unprintable features, print orientation
classes.meaning: This will not print well (overhang, thin wall or unsupported feature); change the geometry or print orientation so it prints flat without supports.

classes.label: Holes or ports blocked
classes.hint: access, cable or screw path blocked
classes.meaning: Access here is blocked (a cable, screw or tool path); clear the path so the hole or port can be used.

classes.label: Fasteners or assembly
classes.hint: screw length, nut access, assembly order
classes.meaning: The fastening or assembly here does not work (screw length, nut access or assembly order); make it possible to assemble with the chosen hardware.

classes.label: Regression
classes.hint: something that was fixed before is broken again
classes.meaning: Something that was fixed before is broken again here; restore the earlier fix without undoing later changes.

classes.label: Belt or pulley
classes.meaning: The belt or pulley here is wrong (path, tension or alignment); align the belt path and give it a working tension method.

classes.label: Envelope or size
classes.hint: outside the allowed envelope, too big or small
classes.meaning: This is outside the allowed envelope or the wrong size; bring it back within the size limits.

classes.label: Intent misread
classes.hint: the agent did something other than what was meant
classes.meaning: This is not what was asked for; reread the request and change this to match what was meant.

classes.label: Other
classes.meaning: Something is wrong here; inspect this spot and fix what does not look intentional.
